8 planets. Age 4.57 billion years. Orbit of Neptune 30.07 AU. Light to Neptune 4.2 hours.
Sie enthält 99,86 % der Masse des Sonnen: It holds 99.86 % of the mass of the solar system. Its light takes a good eight minutes to reach the Earth.
Diameter 1,392,700 km. Surface about 5,500 °C. Spectral class G2V. Rotation at the equator 25 days.
Der kleinste und schnellste Planet. Auf: The smallest and fastest planet. On its strongly elliptical orbit its speed varies between 39 and 59 km/s.
Fast so groß wie die Erde, aber unter di: Almost as large as the Earth, but around 465 °C hot beneath dense clouds. It spins backwards, and a day on Venus lasts longer than its year.
Der einzige bekannte Planet mit flüssige: The only known planet with liquid water on its surface. On the night side the cities glow.
Rund 71 % der Oberfläche sind Wasser, ve: Around 71 % of the surface is water, spread across five oceans. The remaining 29 % form seven continents.
Schnitt vom Mittelpunkt bis zur Oberfläc: Section from the centre to the surface: 6,371 km. The crust is drawn exaggerated; to scale it would be thinner than a line.
Rostrot durch Eisenoxid im Staub. Phobos: Rust-red from iron oxide in the dust. Phobos circles it faster than Mars rotates.
Ein Entwurf nach Studien der Raumfahrtag: A design based on studies by the space agencies. Habitat, rovers, antenna and spacesuits are NASA models; the other structures are reconstructions.
Vesta ist mit 525 km einer der größten A: At 525 km, Vesta is one of the largest asteroids. In the picture the chunks are far closer together than in reality: on average about a million kilometres separate them.
Vesta: Durchmesser 525 km, Umlaufzeit 3,: Vesta: diameter 525 km, orbital period 3.63 years. More than 1.4 million asteroids are known; together they have about 3 percent of the mass of the Moon.
Mehr als doppelt so massereich wie alle: More than twice as massive as all the other planets combined. The Great Red Spot is a storm larger than the Earth.
Its rings of water ice are around 280,000 km across, yet in the main rings mostly only about ten metres thick. The planet casts its shadow on them.
Seine Achse ist um 98° gekippt. Er rollt: Its axis is tilted by 98°. It rolls around the Sun on its side, rings and moons included.
Der sonnenfernste Planet. Seit seiner En: The planet farthest from the Sun. Since its discovery in 1846 it has completed just a single orbit. Triton circles it against the direction of rotation.
